title: Hypergraphs without Subgraphs of Given Connectivity
summary: In this paper, we study the problem of determining the maximum number $F_r(n,k)$ of edges in an $n$-vertex $r$-uniform hypergraph that contains no $(k+1)$-connected subgraph. The graph case, initiated by Mader, is a classical problem in graph theory that remains open. We first establish a limit theorem for $F_r(n,k)$ for all $k\ge r\ge 2$.
